Title: Data Curation Lead
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# Position Title: Data Curation Lead
# Location: National Capital Region
# Category: Contingent
# Schedule (FT/PT): FT
# Travel Required: NA
# Shift: Day
# Remote Type: Hybrid
# Clearance required: Active Secret Clearance required
# Division: Aviation
# Salary: $160,000-$210,000
# ***THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON CONTRACT AWARD***
Who is ACT1 Federal?
ACT1 Federal LLC is a 100% employee-owned company.
We’ve served the Department of Defense (DoD) for nearly thirty years.
Our core missions include weapon systems engineering, logistics, space domain expertise, global defense and security, business and financial management for security assistance and major defense articles, as well as military training and arctic security.
Join us!
Description: Perform data curation, metadata tagging, and data quality preparation activities on CSDR submission data in support of the CSDR data ingestion environment maintained by the Government.
The objective is to ensure that CSDR submissions — the Cost Data Report (Flexfile and 1921 series), the Quantity Data Report, the Technical Data Report, the SRDR, and the M&R, and the CBDR — are properly tagged, normalized, and quality-checked as they move from the submission state into the downstream cost estimating analytical environment.
This task is performed as recurring data stewardship in support of the CSDR mission and is not pipeline development.
# Responsibilities
- Review CSDR submissions for data quality issues including missing values, internal inconsistencies, mis-aligned WBS elements, inflation/escalation treatment, and other issues that would impede downstream analytical use.
- Apply normalization treatments as directed by the AFCAA technical lead, including WBS alignment to the CADE Standard WBS, Cost Element Structure (CES) standardization, and inflation/price-escalation adjustments.
- Document each cleansing and normalization action taken on each submission such that the original-submitted data and the curated data remain distinguishable and traceable.
- Apply metadata tags to CSDR submissions consistent with the AFCAA-approved metadata schema, including programmatic identifiers (program, contract, contractor, contract line item, reporting period, submission type, ACAT level, commodity area, and other approved tags).
- Where new tags are required to support emerging cost estimating analytical needs, the contractor shall recommend additions or modifications to the metadata schema to the AFCAA technical lead for Government concurrence prior to implementation. The contractor shall not unilaterally modify the approved schema.
- Apply technical parameter tagging to Technical Data Report submissions to support discoverability and traceability of form, fit, and function parameters across the program portfolio.
- Perform focused curation of Quantity Data Report submissions, including standardization of quantity-time phasing representations, reconciliation of quantity reporting against contract and program quantities, and tagging of quantity data to support downstream cost-per-unit and learning-curve analysis.
- Perform focused curation of Technical Data Report submissions, including extraction and structured tagging of form, fit, and function parameters; mapping to the approved CSDR Plan technical parameter list; and identification of parameter gaps relative to the cost estimating community's known analytical needs.
- Provide recommendations to the AFCAA technical lead on improvements to the Quantity Data Report and Technical Data Report planning templates and tagging conventions based on patterns observed during curation.
- Perform upstream data preparation activities required for CSDR submissions to be ingested by Government-maintained data infrastructure. These activities are limited to data preparation, tagging, normalization, and quality-check actions performed on the CSDR submission data itself. Configuration, modification, or development of Government data infrastructure is not in scope for this PWS.
- Coordinate with Government data engineers on data format, tagging, and quality issues that affect downstream ingestion.
- Maintain documentation of curation rules, tagging conventions applied, normalization procedures, and data quality findings sufficient for Government personnel to understand, audit, and reproduce the curation work performed.
- Deliver curation and tagging documentation
# Key Skills and Experience
- Data Curation and Stewardship: Demonstrated experience curating large, structured datasets, including data quality assessment, normalization, and traceable documentation of curation actions.
- Metadata and Tagging: Demonstrated experience designing and applying metadata schemas and programmatic tags to structured data, with familiarity with cost-data tagging conventions (program identifier, contract identifier, WBS, CES, ACAT level, commodity).
- CSDR Submission Familiarity: Working familiarity with the CSDR submission set, including the Cost Data Report (FlexFile and 1921-series), the Quantity Data Report, the Technical Data Report, the SRDR, and the M&R.
- Programming and Data Manipulation: Proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience using data-manipulation libraries (Pandas, NumPy, or equivalent) for cleansing and transformation of structured data.
- Data Pipeline Familiarity: Familiarity with data pipeline concepts (ETL/ELT, staging, quality checks) sufficient to support upstream data preparation work. The Key Personnel is not expected to design or develop Government pipelines under this PWS but shall coordinate effectively with the Government pipeline owners.
- Tools Proficiency: Working knowledge of CADE, DACIMS, cPet, PPM, and CSDR-SR submission systems; working familiarity with DAF Data Fabric platforms including VAULT and Envision.
- Documentation and Communication: Strong written documentation skills; ability to communicate data curation findings and tagging recommendations clearly to both cost analyst and data engineering audiences.
# Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree.
- Must have at least ten years of progressively responsible experience in data engineering, data curation, or data science with substantial experience working with DoW cost data, CSDR submissions, or comparable structured technical/financial reporting data.
- CSDR experience is mandatory.
- Expertise shall include a strong understanding of CSDR policy, planning, validation, compliance, and the CADE application.
- Active Secret Clearance required.
# Benefits
- Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
- ACT1 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
- Company Paid Life and AD&D Insurance
- Company Paid Short-Term Disability
- Voluntary Long-Term Disability
- Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- Health Savings Account (HSA)
- 401K with employer match
- Paid Time Off
- Paid Holidays
- Parental Leave
- Military Leave
- Education, Training & Professional Development
- Voluntary Accidental Injury/Critical Illness/Hospital Care
- Voluntary Pet Insurance, Legal Resources, and Identity Protection
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of flexibility and collaboration, whether that happens in person or remotely.
- If this position is listed as remote or hybrid, you’ll periodically work from a ACT1 Federal or client site facility.
- If this position is listed as onsite, you’ll work with colleagues and clients in person, as needed for the specific role.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law.

Title: People Science Analyst 12 month FTC
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

> We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.
> # Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.
> Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work.
> Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams.
> Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.
> Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia.
> Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.
> For more information visit cultureamp.com.
We're looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract.
You'll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action.
GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement.
As a thought leader in HR analytics, you'll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction.
You'll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies.
The work is technical and customer-facing.
You'll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public.
You'll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data.
Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you'll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered.
# As part of this team of amazing humans,
# You will
- Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations
- Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy
- Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes
- Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour
- Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs
- Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership
- Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work
# You have
- An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
- Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideally connecting survey results to business outcomes
- Strong command of inferential statistics, including regression, multi-level analysis and longitudinal analysis, and the judgment to know which method suits which question
- Working proficiency in R, with real experience cleaning and combining messy datasets from multiple sources
- Experience owning complex analytical work end to end, from an initially ambiguous question through to a clear recommendation or conclusion
- A track record of building decks for HR and executive audiences, and presenting them well
- Strong practical understanding of AI tools and workflows, with the judgment to use them to improve quality, efficiency and insight without replacing methodological rigour
- Experience managing stakeholder expectations on scope, timelines and priorities, including when trade-offs or constraints need to be made explicit
- Experience sharing expertise, improving team practice or creating reusable approaches that help others do better work
# You are
- Curious. You ask open questions, get to the underlying problem and resist offering a solution before you understand it
- An independent owner. You can move complex work forward with limited direction, while knowing when to seek input or challenge an assumption
- A translator. You can make a complex finding land with someone who has no statistical training, without dumbing it down
- A thoughtful methodological partner. You are confident about where your expertise is deep, honest about where it isn't, and clear about the implications
- A multiplier. You share what you know, give useful feedback and leave the team with better methods or assets than you found it with
- Open to feedback and quick to act on it
- Energised by intellectually complex work, and comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with open research questions
> # Perks & Benefits
> At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success.
> We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life.
> This includes:
> - Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success
> - Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
> - Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
> - Inclusive parental leave from day one
> - A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
> - Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
> - Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)
> Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.
> Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters.
> If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.
> # Accommodations & Data Privacy
> If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting.
> Do not include any medical or health information in this email.
> The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
> Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion.
> Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period.
> For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real.

# Role Overview
Revenue Strategy & Programs team drives Ads business growth by shaping commercialization strategy and leading high-impact initiatives that accelerate adoption of new advertising products across customer segments.
The team combines go-to-market strategy, and cross-functional execution to bring innovative ad solutions to market and maximize business impact.
As a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Specialist, you will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Data teams to identify market opportunities, develop commercialization strategies, and lead end-to-end go-to-market execution for new advertising products.
You will combine strategic research with operational excellence to ensure successful product launches and scalable growth.
# What You Will Do
- Own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle for new advertising products, from market assessment and launch strategy to execution, adoption, and post-launch optimization.
- Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to identify unmet needs, industry trends, and commercialization opportunities, translating insights into actionable GTM strategies.
- Partner closely with Product teams to influence product roadmap and launch readiness by bringing customer feedback, market intelligence, and business requirements into product development.
- Develop segmentation, positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch recommendations that maximize product adoption and revenue growth.
- Lead cross-functional launch planning and execution across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Data teams, ensuring organizational readiness and consistent stakeholder alignment.
- Define launch success metrics and measurement frameworks, monitor product adoption and business performance, and continuously optimize GTM strategies based on data and customer feedback.
- Scale successful launches by developing repeatable GTM playbooks, enablement materials, best practices, and standardized commercialization processes.
- Communicate market insights, launch performance, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership to influence product strategy and business investment decisions.
- Establish and lead weekly and monthly business reviews with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, driving alignment on priorities, performance, risks, and action plans.
- Identify key growth bottlenecks and adoption barriers through data-driven analysis, and develop targeted sales programs, commercialization strategies, and promotional initiatives to accelerate product adoption and revenue growth.
# Minimum Qualifications
- 8–10 years of experience in program management, business operations, strategy, or related roles within e-commerce, advertising, or tech companies
- Proven track record of leading and delivering complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end, from strategy and planning through execution and measurable business impact
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations
- Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Product, Marketing) without direct authority
- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations and insights effectively to senior leadership
# Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in advertising, media, performance marketing, or related commercial functions
- Experience designing and managing revenue programs, pricing and packaging strategies, or go-to-market (GTM) initiatives at scale
- Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) to analyze business performance and generate actionable insights
- Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce
- Business-level English proficiency with the ability to collaborate effectively across regional and global teams

As a Director of AI Experience Design within the AI Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how AI transforms the advisor, client, and employee experience across Edelman Financial Engines.
This role is responsible for defining and driving a human-centered AI experience strategy that combines behavioral science, design thinking, and data-driven decision making to create intuitive, trusted, and outcome-oriented AI solutions.
You will champion a deep understanding of user behavior, needs, motivations, and decision-making patterns to influence the design of AI-powered tools, workflows, recommendations, and agentic experiences that drive adoption, engagement, trust, productivity, and business impact.
In addition to being a highly collaborative and influential leader, we are seeking a candidate who brings a unique blend of UX leadership, behavioral design expertise, and AI product innovation.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of translating complex technologies into simple, intuitive experiences and using behavioral insights, user research, and data to drive measurable results.
If you are passionate about designing the future of human-AI interaction, thrive in rapidly evolving environments, and believe exceptional experiences should be measured not only by usability but by the outcomes they create, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of AI at Edelman Financial Engines.
# Responsibilities
- AI Integration & Design
- Define and champion experience principles for AI-powered products, tools, and workflows across the organization.
- Design conversational, multimodal, and agent-assisted experiences that support natural and intuitive user interactions.
- Create user journeys that effectively blend human expertise with AI-driven recommendations and automation.
- Establish AI UX standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines that promote consistency, accessibility, trust, and usability.
- Conduct user research to understand customer behaviors, needs, mental models, and emerging expectations related to AI-driven experiences.
- Drive the development of personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and experience frameworks for AI-enabled products.
- Ensure AI experiences are transparent, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
- Product Design Execution & Collaboration
- Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Architects, and Data teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high-quality AI-centered experiences.
- Translate user insights into wireframes, prototypes, workflows, and interaction designs that can be rapidly tested and validated.
- Participate in product discovery, experimentation, and iterative design processes to continuously improve user outcomes.
- Collaborate across multiple squads to drive experience consistency across products, channels, and business capabilities.
- Advocate for user-centric decision-making throughout planning, prioritization, and execution activities.
- Facilitate design reviews and experience assessments to ensure solutions meet usability and accessibility standards
- Continuous Optimization
- Leverage analytics and user feedback to refine and improve human-led, AI-enabled experiences
- Monitor performance of AI-enabled features and drive optimization
- Ensure consistent and responsible utilization of AI across multiple execution teams
# Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree required
- 5-10+ years of experience spanning UX design, product design
- Experience deploying AI/ML solutions in regulated environments (financial services strongly preferred)
- Experience with Product development lifecycle from ideation to execution
- Experience working with Agile product teams
- Strong understanding of AI/ML ecosystems, LLMs, data platforms, and orchestration layers.
- Track record of balancing innovation, risk, and regulatory compliance.
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders in different areas (ex: Data, Architecture, Compliance)
- Experience working with ADA Compliant design
- Strong understanding of AI (within the landscape of regulated industries preferred)
- Ability to design experiences that build user trust, transparency, and confidence in AI-driven interactions.
- Proficiency in journey mapping, prototyping, wireframing, design systems, and usability testing.
- Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology teams.
- Ability to understand interdependent ecosystems and proactively look for opportunities for scale and consistency.
- Ability to leverage data to drive optimization across tool sets
